applies_to: features with properties.layer_role == 'rebel_control' (always badge CONTESTED, plus APPROXIMATE or DERIVED as cited)

pattern.type: cross-hatch (45° and -45°) – distinct from the single-direction amber contested hatch and the pale low-confidence hatch
pattern.svg_template: <pattern id="rebel-xhatch-{actor}" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="10" height="10"><rect width="10" height="10" fill="{colour}" fill-opacity=".10"/><path d="M0 0L10 10M10 0L0 10" stroke="#0f1b24" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M0 0L10 10M10 0L0 10" stroke="{colour}" stroke-width="1.5"/></pattern>
pattern.counter_scale: patternTransform scale(1/K) in hatchK(), so spacing stays ~10 px at every zoom (mobile readable)
pattern.dark_understroke: #0f1b24 under each line keeps >=3:1 on light and dark era fills

by_certainty.CONTESTED+APPROXIMATE: pattern fill-opacity as above, dashed outline 6 3
by_certainty.CONTESTED+DERIVED: same pattern, outline dasharray 2 3 (dotted) to show the edge is derived, not mapped
by_certainty.point_only_claim: no polygon; badge_contested.svg diamond at the cited point, 14 px, actor colour ring

mobile.below_zoom_k_1_5: drop the fill tint, keep cross-hatch + outline
mobile.label: actor short name EN/AR, 11 px, halo #0f1b24 2px

claim_marker.applies_to: db/control_post1956.json records with place_id (town pin) and rebel:true records in db/control_layers/control_pre1956.geojson
claim_marker.shape: square pin rotated 0° (NOT the battle disc/diamond family, NOT the siege ring): 14×14 px square with cross-hatch in actor colour + 2 px actor-colour ring + dark #0f1b24 halo; CONTESTED diamond badge (badge_contested.svg, 8 px) top-right
claim_marker.distinct_from_siege: siege/battle records (db/battles_post1956.json, battle_*.svg) use discs/diamonds/ticks and describe events; claim pins are squares and describe reported control at a date
